correctness.rationale: Complement of visited (n−2)-subset is a 2-edge; a pair remains uncollected iff it hits every omitted edge, giving stopping time when graph vertex-cover number ≥3. With no fresh-label collision, visited edges form a growth tree with distinguished pendant edge; dynamic programming on cover costs (A,B) gives absorbing 5+two independent Geom-failure fair variables, pgf z⁵/(2−z)², E=7, variance=4. At j exposed edges collision hazard≤(j−1)/(n−2), so summing to ideal stopping yields TV≤E[(T∞−1)(T∞−2)]/[2(n−2)]=17/(n−2). A uniform 4-step fresh path with probability≥3/256 bounds all tails and ensures expectation convergence. Restricted-growth enumeration of four transitions distinguishes 4 new labels in 4(n−2)(n−3)(n−4)(n−5) paths and 3 new in 10(n−2)(n−3)(n−4); dividing by [2(n−2)]⁴ gives the stated exact P(T_n=5). Independently enumerated direct finite n=6,7,8 giving 21/256, 27/250, 55/432. These finite checks support, but do not substitute for, uniform coupling proof.
